Self-directed and motivated to seek out opportunities to contribute to projects to help the department. Coordinates and is active in at least two special projects per year within the department or [Product name masked], along with other miscellaneous department duties. The role serves as a department resource and takes ownership of ensuring compliance with all pertinent laboratory accrediting agency and regulatory requirements (e.g., CLIA '88, JCAHO, CAP, OSHA).
cond_0512.responsibilities:
Perform all MLS/MT duties as defined by the department at a high level of competency.
Direct operational leadership and workflow oversight for the section/shift.
Apply comprehensive technical knowledge and clinical relevance to daily department activity.
Lead complex problem solving of technical, computer, interdepartmental, and quality issues.
Under the direction of the Supervisor and/or Technical Director, drive implementation of system technical initiatives within the area of responsibility.
Provide onsite supervision (determine schedules, manage day-to-day workflow, and give input into assessments or disciplinary actions) in the absence of the section supervisor.
Ensure quality by reviewing records and confirming performance of all quality control and assurance procedures.
Maintain quality control and instrumentation maintenance records to meet accrediting and licensing agency standards.
Lead implementation of new QC/QA policies and continuous quality improvement programs in coordination with the Supervisor, Administrative and Technical Directors, and Technical Specialist, in accordance with the Quality System.
Take an active role in department and [Company name masked] quality assurance activities.
Monitor and ensure compliance with accrediting agency and regulatory requirements for the laboratory.
Drive preparation for on-site accrediting processes.
Identify and act on opportunities to improve financial performance, decrease costs, increase productivity, and improve service.
Manage inventory and bring related issues forward for prompt resolution.
Execute cost analysis models.
Oversee basic personnel functions including participation in selection, training, development, and coaching under the direction of the Supervisor or appropriate Director.
Lead new employee orientation, training, and competency activities.
Deliver input for competency and annual assessments for employees within appropriate timeframes.
Take ownership of implementing and ensuring staff completion of competency program requirements.
Seek out opportunities to contribute to projects that benefit the department.
Lead and execute at least two special projects per year within the department or [Company name masked], along with other miscellaneous department duties.
Serve as the primary communication liaison for on-site and system issues.
Connect staff to other system resources when appropriate.
Work closely with on-site management to integrate the area into broader on-site activities.
Foster teamwork and a customer service focus among co-workers.
Demonstrate preceptor and coaching skills and promote a constructive environment that encourages learning and development.
Demonstrate appropriate verbal and written communication skills.
cond_0512.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in a chemical, physical, biological, or clinical laboratory science or medical technology
Two (2) years' experience in nonwaived testing in the designated specialty/sub-specialty area
MLS or Specialty Certification
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Medical Laboratory Science
[Company name masked] supports a drug-free work environment.

The role serves as a department resource and helps ensure compliance with all pertinent laboratory accrediting agency and regulatory requirements (e.g., CLIA '88, JCAHO, CAP, OSHA).
cond_0522.responsibilities:
Performs all MLS/MT duties as defined by the department, at a high level of competency.
Coordinates operational workflow and provides oversight to the section/shift.
Integrates comprehensive technical knowledge and clinical relevance into daily activity for the department.
Works with the team to resolve complex technical, computer, interdepartmental, and quality issues.
Under the direction of the Supervisor and/or Technical Director, supports implementation of system technical initiatives in their area of responsibility.
Provides onsite supervision (coordinates schedules, helps manage day-to-day workflow, and contributes input into assessments or disciplinary actions) in the absence of the section supervisor.
Reviews records and works with staff to ensure performance of all quality control and assurance procedures.
Helps ensure that quality control and instrumentation maintenance records are kept and documentation meets standards of accrediting and licensing agencies.
Assists the Supervisor, Administrative and Technical Directors, and Technical Specialist in implementing new QC/QA policies and continuous quality improvement programs in accordance with the Quality System.
Participates in department and [Company name masked] quality assurance activities.
Monitors and helps ensure compliance with accrediting agency and regulatory requirements for the laboratory.
Actively participates in preparation for on-site accrediting processes.
Works with the team to identify opportunities for improvement and supports efforts to improve financial performance, decrease costs, increase productivity, and improve service.
Monitors inventory and brings related issues forward for prompt resolution.
Assists with cost analysis models.
Supports basic personnel oversight including participation in selection, training, development, and coaching under the direction of the Supervisor or appropriate Director.
Assists in new employee orientation, training, and competency.
Contributes input for competency and annual assessments for employees within appropriate time frames.
Actively involved in coordinating and ensuring staff completion of competency program requirements.
Seeks out opportunities to contribute to projects that help the department.
Coordinates and participates in at least two special projects per year within the department or [Company name masked], along with other miscellaneous department duties.
Serves as a resource and communication liaison for on-site and system issues.
Connects staff with other system resources when appropriate.
Works closely with on-site management to integrate the area into other on-site activities.
Engages with co-workers with an emphasis on teamwork and a focus on customer service.
Demonstrates preceptor and coaching skills and promotes a constructive environment that encourages learning and development.
Demonstrates appropriate verbal and written skills.
cond_0522.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree in a chemical, physical, biological, or clinical laboratory science or medical technology.
Bachelor's Degree in Medical Laboratory Science.
Two (2) years' experience in nonwaived testing in the designated specialty/sub-specialty area.
MLS or Specialty Certification.

Performs all duties of MLS/MT duties as defined by the department, at a high level of competency. Responsible for operational leadership and workflow oversight to the section/shift. Integrates comprehensive technical knowledge and clinical relevance into daily activity for the department. Responsible for complex problem solving of technical, computer, interdepartmental and quality issues. Under the direction of the Supervisor and/or Technical Director, responsible for implementation of system technical initiatives in their area of responsibility. Provides onsite supervision (determines schedules, manage day to day work flow and give input into an assessment or disciplinary action) in the absence of section supervisor. Focuses on quality by reviewing records and assuring performance of all quality control and assurance procedures. Ensures that quality control and instrumentation maintenance records are kept and documentation meets standards of accrediting and licensing agencies. Assists the Supervisor, Administrative and Technical Directors, and Technical Specialist, in the implementation of new QC/QA polices and continuous quality improvement programs in accordance with the Quality System. Active in department and LSA/SQL System quality assurance activities. Monitors and ensures compliance with accrediting agency and regulatory requirements for the laboratory. Actively participates in preparation for on-site accrediting process. Monitors, recognizes opportunities for improvement, and participates in improving the financial performance of the department and the LSA/SQL System to decrease costs, increase productivity, and improve service. Monitors inventory and brings related issues forward for prompt resolution. Assists with cost analysis models. Assists with basic personnel oversight including participation in selection, training, developing, and providing coaching under the direction of the Supervisor or appropriate Director. Assists in new employee orientation, training and competency. Provides input for competency and annual assessments for employees in appropriate time frames. Actively involved in implementing and ensuring staff completion of competency program requirements. Self-directed and motivated to seek out opportunities to contribute to projects to help the department. Coordinates and is active in at least two special projects per year within the department or LSA/SQL System, along with other miscellaneous department duties. Serves as a resource communication liaison for on-site and System issues. Provides access to other System resources when appropriate. Works closely with on-site management to integrate the area into other activities on-site. Interacts with co-workers with an emphasis on teamwork and a focus on customer service. Demonstrates preceptor and coaching skills and promotes a constructive environment that encourages learning and development. Demonstrates appropriate verbal and written skills.
cond_0579.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a chemical, physical, biological, or clinical laboratory science, medical technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Around 2 years of experience in nonwaived testing in the designated specialty/sub-specialty area, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
MLS or Specialty Certification, or willingness to obtain.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Medical Laboratory Science.
Our organization supports a drug-free work environment.
